description: §39.2 / §14.8.10 — a `<schema>` declares table `assets` twice: a commented-out stale copy WITHOUT `tenant_id` and the live declaration WITH it. Every declaration the compiler reads (a commented-out copy included) counts, and the tenant floor reads their union; same-name declarations that disagree on `tenant_id` are rejected with E-SCHEMA-015 (before S450 the stale copy won first-wins and the live `tenant_id` table was silently not tenant-scoped).
rationale: §39.2 (Comments and literals): same-name `<schema>` declarations that disagree on whether the table carries a `tenant_id` column SHALL be a compile error (E-SCHEMA-015). Provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S447 "stamp all" (i).
